platform.name: Inventory Management Agent
platform.description: A plant-material control workspace that combines production plans, BOM consumption, stock snapshots, inbound receipts, buyer ownership and supplier follow-up into daily inventory decisions.
platform.business_outcome: Protect planned production from material shortages while identifying possible excess and maintaining evidence for inventory and inwarding exceptions.
platform.maturity: Working MVP on localhost; production readiness is not evidenced.
platform.environment: Localhost only; no staging or production deployment is evidenced.
repository_evidence: app.py:11710-11723 defines the active specialist navigation.
app.py:11930-11964 defines the active inventory workspaces.
requirements.txt identifies Streamlit, pandas, Google API/OAuth and Trino dependencies.

chakra_position.subtitle: Daily stock, requirements, receipts, consumption and buyer action control.
chakra_position.status: Pilot candidate; currently a working local MVP.
chakra_position.purpose: Coordinate plant-material availability and exceptions against daily production execution.

home_map_card.business_outcome: Protect production and reduce avoidable material shortages or excess.
home_map_card.upstream_connection: Production, BOM, stock, receipt and ownership spreadsheets
home_map_card.downstream_connection: Buyer work queues, supplier follow-ups, PPC responses and audit evidence

home_map_card.tooltip: Controls daily material readiness by combining plans, BOM demand, stock, inwarding and buyer-owned exceptions.

workflows.name: Refresh and retain source snapshots
workflows.trigger: A user selects Refresh all sources, or the enabled in-session 15-minute fragment runs.
workflows.end_condition: Each available source has a saved local CSV snapshot and failures are reported without replacing the previous copy.
steps: Authenticate to Google Sheets with read-only scope.
Fetch each configured sheet.
Normalize source frames and save snapshots atomically.
Recompute dependent material and issue views.
Retain previous snapshots for any failed source and show a partial-failure summary.

workflows.end_condition: A deduplicated CSV and metadata file are written, or the script exits with an error.
steps: Read environment configuration.
Query Trino directly or call the Superset API.
Validate expected columns.
Deduplicate records.
Write output and metadata atomically.

modules.name: Inventory Position and Reconciliation
modules.purpose: Calculate operational and system stock views, expose health queues and retain correction evidence.
modules.status: Working locally with important source and authorization limitations.

workflows.name: Calculate daily inventory position
workflows.trigger: Source snapshots or editable variant operating inputs change and the Streamlit app reruns.
workflows.end_condition: Part-level stock, movement, requirement, shortage, delta and status fields are calculated.
inputs: manual other outwarding if present in data
steps: Match planned parts to exact SCM stock records.
Aggregate selected-date inwarding and outwarding.
Calculate generated and produced P-VIN component consumption.
Calculate tomorrow opening stock as today's opening stock plus inwarding minus outwarding.
Calculate system stock, physical stock and COGI.
Calculate supplier requirement from system stock and operational shortage from physical stock.
Classify stock health and unexplained deltas.

workflows.name: Investigate and record inventory corrections
workflows.trigger: A user opens Audit and Evidence or identifies an exception in a stock queue.
workflows.end_condition: Evidence is reviewed and a correction request has a recorded decision; source stock is not automatically changed.
steps: Inspect part-level calculation evidence or exception queue.
Enter proposed stock value, reason, requester and approver.
Save a pending correction request.
An approver records Approved, Rejected or Applied externally.
Any actual source-system correction occurs outside this application.
approvals: Correction decision is recorded by a human approver; identity and permissions are not enforced.

modules.name: Material Requirements and Supplier Control
modules.purpose: Convert material demand and stock into buyer-owned shortage or excess queues and supplier follow-up records.
modules.status: Working locally; supplier communications, open POs, safety stock and enforced approvals are not integrated.

workflows.name: Plan shortage coverage and supplier follow-up
workflows.trigger: A current inventory calculation is available and a user selects Today, Rolling 7 Days or Remaining Month.
workflows.end_condition: A buyer has saved a complete supplier action, or the requirement is otherwise reviewed outside the application.
steps: Aggregate part demand across the selected horizon.
Compare demand with stock and find the first shortage date.
Classify Critical, High or Medium severity.
Filter the queue by buyer and that buyer's suppliers.
Capture supplier status, expected quantity, delivery date, next follow-up, owner and notes.
Generate deterministic quantity, timing and PPC response bullets.
Save the follow-up locally.
approvals: PPC plan adjustment is presented as a recommendation; approval/execution is not implemented.

workflows.name: Screen potential excess
workflows.trigger: A user switches Requirements to Potential excess and selects a planning horizon.
workflows.end_condition: Potential-excess parts are reviewed; no automatic supply change is made.
steps: Aggregate demand for the chosen horizon.
Compare physical stock with planned consumption.
Flag possible surplus.
Present filters and review evidence.
Require human validation before changing supplier commitments.
approvals: Any reduction or cancellation of supply requires an external human decision.
exceptions: potential signal may be false positive

modules.name: Inbound Materials Control
modules.purpose: Fact-check direct gate entries, assign issues to buyers and maintain a verifiable discrepancy lifecycle.
modules.status: Working locally against saved Google Sheet snapshots; no source write-back or notification integration.

workflows.name: Refresh and review inwarding
workflows.trigger: A connected user selects Refresh on Inwarding Parts or the master refresh includes the source.
workflows.end_condition: The latest valid direct-gate-entry snapshot is saved and can be filtered or downloaded.
steps: Read the gate-entry and buyer-mapping sheets.
Clean and cache the data.
Map buyer by part first and supplier as fallback.
Filter by date, gate entry, part, buyer, supplier and unloading status.
Show receipt totals, latest entry and mapping coverage.

workflows.name: Resolve inwarding discrepancies
workflows.trigger: A refreshed inwarding snapshot is reconciled against persistent action records.
workflows.end_condition: A refreshed source no longer contains the issue and the action is auto-resolved, or the issue remains assigned for human follow-up.
steps: Detect quantity, ownership, required-field, unloading and duplicate issues.
Assign severity, age, production risk and escalation.
Map the issue to a buyer or SCM Admin fallback.
Allow the buyer to acknowledge, investigate or await source correction.
Reconcile on refresh and auto-resolve only when source evidence is clean.
Reopen a previously resolved case if it recurs.
approvals: Manual resolution is intentionally not permitted; refreshed source evidence verifies closure.

workflows.name: Calculate variant and P-VIN material consumption
workflows.trigger: Production-plan, VIN, variant-operating or P-VIN input data changes.
workflows.end_condition: Variant-level totals and component-level generated/produced consumption are recalculated.
steps: Parse the daily plan and production break-up.
Apply locally saved editable variant operating values.
Map variants to finished-good codes.
Explode finished-good quantities through BOM usage.
Calculate generated and produced P-VIN part consumption.
Feed all dependent inventory, requirement and reconciliation calculations.

workflows.name: Calculate and review daily outwarding
workflows.trigger: A user refreshes calculation sources or opens the saved Outwarding Parts view.
workflows.end_condition: Daily part usage is calculated, cached, filtered and optionally downloaded.
steps: Build exact finished-goods production by day.
Multiply actual output by BOM quantities.
Group component consumption by date and part.
Combine any manual outwarding records.
Show and download filtered usage.
Report unmapped production and missing BOM finished-good codes.

open_questions.question: Is HS01 daily material control the formally approved scope, or must Chakra represent additional plants or storage locations?
Which variant/P-VIN fields are authoritative system actuals, and which are temporary human-entered overrides?
Should supplier requirement remain driven by system stock and operational shortage by physical stock in the production design?
Which team owns the platform and each of the stock, BOM, production, inwarding and buyer-mapping data domains?
Who are the accountable business owner and technical owner?
Which source is authoritative for today's opening stock, and what is its required intraday freshness SLA?
Is the HEADER PARTS workbook an approved BOM source or a temporary gap-filling supplement?
Should inwarded quantity use Invoice Qty permanently, and how should Receipt Qty influence discrepancy and stock posting?
Is a saved supplier follow-up a draft internal note, a buyer commitment, or an instruction that must be sent to another system?
Who may approve stock corrections, supplier commitment changes and PPC plan adjustments, and what segregation of duties is required?
What thresholds and owners should govern stock-delta, stale-data, COGI and human non-response escalations?
Has this local MVP been used in a controlled pilot, and which workflows have business acceptance?
Will Google Sheets remain the source interface, or are ERP/MES/WMS APIs or events planned as authoritative feeds?
Is the Trino/Superset GRN export intended to replace the Direct Gate Entry sheet or serve a separate reconciliation purpose?
Which procurement, supplier-portal, PPC, ERP or communication system should receive approved actions?
Which identifiers and versioning rules will Chakra use for parts, variants, suppliers, buyers, actions and correction requests?
Should Chakra embed these specialist views, call a future service API, or consume read models and action events?
What hosting, identity provider, data store, monitoring, backup and environment model are approved for pilot and production?
